claim_boundary: A pass supports only an aggregate archive return-stream claim for the exact AQR sleeve. It does not prove current positions, ticker selection, ETF/futures implementation, costs, capacity, or prospective profitability.
excluded_period: 2012 calendar year is excluded as publication-transition buffer.
formula: Use the published AQR factor returns exactly as supplied; no parameter search or transformation.

inference.block_bootstrap: moving block length 12 months, 20000 deterministic repetitions, seed 7801
inference.mean_test: one-sided mean above hurdle using Newey-West HAC standard error lag 6
inference.multiplicity: Bonferroni across the five frozen sleeves separately within each period and hurdle

input.data_limit: Maintained reconstructed archive; not a historical vintage and not instrument-level positions.
input.source: AQR Time Series Momentum Factors, Monthly

purpose: Test one canonical, literature-fixed 12-month/1-month time-series momentum family across aggregate multi-asset sleeves without tuning.
